user.title: Smart Solity
user.description: Enter your Smart Solity account (email / password).

reconfigure.title: Change account
reconfigure.description: Log in with another Smart Solity account that has this door lock (e.g. a member account invited from the app, used only by Home Assistant). Entities are kept.

reconfigure_device.title: Select door lock
reconfigure_device.description: This account has several door locks. Pick the one this entry controls (its entities are kept).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Smart Solity server.
error.no_devices: No door locks found on this account.
error.device_not_shared: No door lock was found on this account. Invite it as a member from the owner's app (and accept the invite) first.

abort.already_configured: This door lock is already configured.

init.title: Smart Solity options
init.description: Event-log polling (5–600s) reads the cloud log and does not wake the lock. Status polling (1–1440 min) wakes the lock, so keep it slow. After every open the lock is checked until the deadbolt is out again, paced by the door state the lock reports (closed: recheck in 1.5s, open: back off).

session_taken.title: Smart Solity account is also used by the app
session_taken.description: The Smart Solity server allows only one login per account. Home Assistant and the phone app using {email} keep logging each other out. Create a second account, invite it as a member from the owner's app, then switch Home Assistant to it: Settings → Devices & services → Smart Solity → ⋮ → Reconfigure.
